game_concept: A racing platformer set in Mt. Pyre – Sulfur Springs, steaming sulfur springs: the volcanologist must handle ember hounds while practicing data types & operators. Core idea – Rounding Range: Use round() and abs() to snap messy measurements into valid slots.
theme: Mt. Pyre – Sulfur Springs: steaming sulfur springs
core_gameplay_loop: In Sulfur Springs, repeat each round: Use round() and abs() to snap messy measurements into valid slots. Each round the rival advances, and solving the step moves the volcanologist ahead. Then check the slot_matches value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Bonus coins for fast correct moves
player_objective: Beat a rival AI to the fire shrine by solving code steps involving slot_matches that move the volcanologist forward.
controls: Touch: tap tiles or buttons to choose values, swipe to move, long-press for a hint.
win_condition: Player progress reaches 100% before the rival does (rival speed 0.85).
lose_condition: The rival reaches the fire shrine first, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 2 – Data Types & Operators | Level 2 (intro tier): Rounding Range
assets_style: pixel-art volcano: purple-black rock, glowing lava rivers, orange ember light, drifting ash; flat Kenney-style sprites; low war drums, rumbling bass and crackling fire effects
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Rounding Range' (Week 2 slot 13), mission type 'Rival Race', and setting 'Sulfur Springs'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Mt. Pyre
region.mood: low war drums, rumbling bass and crackling fire effects

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how slot_matches changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against ember hounds in Sulfur Springs.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Player progress reaches 100% before the rival does (rival speed 0.85).
